title: Naturality of the transported boundary under morphisms of squares
statement: For injectively exact squares S and T and a morphism of underived squares φ : S.toSquare ⟶ T.toSquare, the explicitly transported boundaries satisfy S.boundary F n ≫ (NatTrans.rightDerived φ.τ₁ (n + 1)).app F = (NatTrans.rightDerived φ.τ₄ n).app F ≫ T.boundary F n for every F and n.

proof.text: Apply HomologicalComplex.HomologySequence.δ_naturality to the morphism of the two short exact resolution sequences induced termwise by the four components of φ; transport the equality through InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj and identify the outer derived maps by NatTrans.rightDerived_app_eq.

lean.statement: theorem boundary_square_naturality (S : InjectivelyExactSquare.{u, v, w} C) (n : ℕ) : ∀ (T : InjectivelyExactSquare.{u, v, w} C) (φ : S.toSquare ⟶ T.toSquare) (F : C), S.boundary F n ≫ (NatTrans.rightDerived φ.τ₁ (n + 1)).app F = (NatTrans.rightDerived φ.τ₄ n).app F ≫ T.boundary F n
